name: read-aloud
description: Speak the last reply aloud on demand, in a macOS Personal Voice, with pause, skip and speed above the prompt.

voice.title: Voice
voice.description: The voice replies are read in, by name or identifier. Ember is the Personal Voice.

norwegianVoice.title: Norwegian voice
norwegianVoice.description: The voice used instead when a reply reads as Norwegian. Only used if macOS has it.

rates.title: Rate steps
rates.description: The speeds the rate button walks, as comma-separated multipliers of the normal speaking rate.

maxChars.title: Longest reply to read
maxChars.description: How much of a reply is read out at most, before it is cut at a word.

speaker.title: EmberSpeak path
speaker.description: Path to the EmberSpeak executable, which is what can speak a Personal Voice. Absent or missing, the built-in system voice is used instead.
